context: A mother weighs enrolling her daughter in cram school
purpose: Decide on cram school; teach 塾/深夜/実力/選ば/起こっ/持た

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 娘を塾に入れるか迷っています。
lines.en: I am unsure whether to enroll my daughter in cram school.
lines.style: hesitant mother seeking guidance, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 塾は深夜まで拘束されることもあります。
lines.en: Cram school can keep them until late night.
lines.style: candid teacher laying out the reality

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: A late-night commute home worries me.
lines.style: protective mother voicing concern, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本人の実力に合う所を選ばせましょう。
lines.en: Let her choose a place that fits her ability.
lines.style: wise teacher advising a tailored fit

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 実力に合わないと続きませんよね。
lines.en: If it does not match her ability she will not last.
lines.style: thoughtful mother agreeing on fit, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 何か問題が起こったらすぐ相談を。
lines.en: If any problem happens, consult me right away.
lines.style: supportive teacher offering an open door

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 子どもに責任を持たせたいんです。
lines.en: I want to give my child a sense of responsibility.
lines.style: principled mother stating her hope, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いい考えです。自覚を持たせるのは大事です。
lines.en: A good idea. Instilling awareness matters.
lines.style: approving teacher endorsing the value, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 体調を崩すことが起こらないか心配で。
lines.en: I worry her health might give out.
lines.style: caring mother lingering on her fears
